original_record.question:
Elvis has 6 triangles with this pattern
<image1>
Which picture can he make with them?
<image2>
original_record.subject: combinatorial geometry

inventory.image1: downward equilateral triangular card, pale fill, X at outer edge, crossbar and inner V
inventory.image2: five six-sector regular hexagons A-E; B adds X-side uprights, C omits crossbars, D substitutes inner horizontal bars for Vs, E widens outer endpoints of each X

answer_verification.method: A consists of six exact rigid rotations of supplied triangular card. B adds two lines per card; C removes the crossbar; D changes inner V into a horizontal segment; E changes endpoints of the X on the outer side. Hence only A preserves every card motif.

audit.explicit_conditions_vs_layout: Geometry and option identity preserved. Locations and panel spacing are display layout only.

representation_note: The original question/options/answer remain verbatim in original_record and original_question. A Choices block is appended only to expose the unchanged source options in the common answer schema.
